notes.center-for-community-c4c: The Center for Community holds the C4C Dining Center, CU Boulder's main dining hall (colorado.edu/living/dining); its name doesn't say dining.
notes.carlson-gymnasium: Carlson Gym holds Integrative Physiology classrooms and labs (Facilities code CARL); the Student Recreation Center is the student gym, so Carlson ranks as a class building.
notes.chautauqua-dining-hall: The Chautauqua Dining Hall is a restaurant at Chautauqua Park west of campus, not a CU dining hall (Facilities code DHLL names the leased building).
notes.folsom-field: The football stadium, a varsity venue, not a class building (Facilities codes STAD/STSB/FHPB).
notes.balch-fieldhouse: Varsity athletics fieldhouse beside Folsom Field, not a class building or student gym.
notes.champions-center: Varsity athletics offices and training centre, not a class building.
notes.dal-ward-athletic-center: Academic-support centre for varsity athletes, not a class building or student gym.
notes.basketball-and-volleyball-practice-facil: Varsity practice gym (Facilities code EVNT), not a student gym.
notes.stadium-ticket-building: The athletics ticket office, not somewhere classes happen.
notes.limelight-boulder: The Limelight hotel and conference centre (Facilities code CCH), not a class building.
notes.east-district-energy-plant: A utility plant, not somewhere classes happen.
notes.university-of-colorado: OSM names this building only 'University of Colorado'; Facilities code WDEP is the West District Energy Plant, a utility building.
notes.grounds-and-recycling-operations-center: Facilities grounds and recycling operations, a service building.
notes.environmental-health-and-safety-center: Environmental Health and Safety offices, a service building.
notes.university-admin-center-annex: University administration annex (temporary building 19), not classrooms.
notes.wardenburg-health-center: The student health clinic, not somewhere classes happen.
notes.university-club: The faculty and staff club, not a class building.
notes.cu-art-museum: The CU Art Museum (OSM tourism=museum, no Facilities code of its own), part of the Visual Arts Complex which stays.
notes.family-housing-childrens-center: Childcare for family housing, not somewhere classes happen.
notes.laundry: The Newton Court family-housing laundry, a service building.
notes.marine-court-mail: The Marine Court family-housing mail room; the Facilities footprints for Marine Court A-M (apartments) word-matched to it.
notes.folsom-bike-station: A bike repair station, not a building classes happen in.
notes.koenig-alumni-center: Alumni centre, not somewhere classes happen.
notes.page-foundation-center: CU Foundation offices, not somewhere classes happen.
notes.native-american-rights-fund: The Native American Rights Fund's own offices on Broadway, not a university building.
notes.national-indian-law-library: The Native American Rights Fund's law library on Broadway, not a university library; Norlin is the campus library.
